title: Scope record
description: Produced by the coordinator when it establishes scope, completed by the time the panel is seated. Grounds every assignment justification; the report's panel and context sections draw from it.

request_summary.description: One or two sentences: what the user asked for.

boundary.description: The program or system boundary under analysis.

evidence_refs.description: Repositories, documents, logs, or artifacts consulted to establish scope.

constraints.description: Stated goals, non-goals, budgets, deadlines, and doctrine that bind the analysis.

unknowns.description: Material facts that are missing, stated instead of invented.

languages.description: Every materially involved language or DSL, judged by content. Each entry records whether a language expert was seated; an empty array states that none is materially involved.

evidence.description: Where in the scope this language materially appears.

reason.description: Why a language expert was or was not seated.

test_command.description: How to run the scope's own test suite, when one exists and the environment allows running it.

execution_mode.description: The Librarian, Tech lead, and experts run separately, and every expert uses a non-inheriting spawn, so private familiarity checks cannot enter expert context.
